Processing in the same machine.

This requirement is not modified since v4.0.3 and I think it requires work anyway:
* what is the precise security problem to solve with this?
* what means "securely transmitted"?
* what is "a remote system"?

I would say that the scope for ASVS is that the application produces the information into the logs (contain expected information) in expected format (no log injections), but what happens later with the logs, may be out of scope already.
